TEXT_DESCRIPTION_1: **Full-stack developer** from Ensenada, Mexico. I build **web and mobile apps**, from the interface to the systems behind it.

EXPERIENCE.title: Shopify Developer
EXPERIENCE.description: I build Shopify storefront features for 10 e-commerce brands, from Black Friday launches to product page redesigns and A/B tests. I also moved an industrial supplier's two stores off Magento and built a prototype AI assistant for the agency.

EXPERIENCE.title: Freelance Frontend Developer
EXPERIENCE.description: Building the booking site for a yacht and sport-fishing charter company in Los Cabos with Next.js and Strapi. I launched its destination guide for 15 Mexican ports, with seasonal fishing info and HubSpot lead capture.

EXPERIENCE.title: Intern, Application Developer
EXPERIENCE.description: Shipped React features for a medical AI assistant used across several brands. I also built automated build checks and a Playwright reporting pipeline on AWS.

EXPERIENCE.title: Automated Testing Trainee
EXPERIENCE.description: Built Java UI and API test suites in an enterprise-focused training program. Used Selenium, RestAssured and TestNG with reusable utilities and the Page Object Model.

EXPERIENCE.title: Software Developer & Research Assistant
EXPERIENCE.description: Designed the app architecture and set up its Supabase backend with PostgreSQL and row-level security. Built 20+ React Native screens and a questionnaire engine that accepts new screening instruments through configuration.

PROJECTS.title: Stilo
PROJECTS.description: I build an app that builds outfits from the clothes you already own. Snap a photo and it cuts out and tags the piece, then ask for an outfit for any occasion or drag pieces onto a canvas. In a 10-person study, AI-assisted outfits took 83.4% fewer interactions than building them by hand.
PROJECTS.context: Co-Author & Developer • Paper accepted at MexIHC 2026
contributions: Designed the outfit pipeline: an LLM plans the look, embedding search finds matching pieces in your closet, and a second pass composes or edits the outfit.
Built the Expo app, including the closet, the AI studio and the drag-and-drop outfit canvas.
Moved the backend from NestJS, FastAPI and Postgres on Azure to one Cloudflare Worker with D1 and R2, with a parity suite checking each operation against the old API.

PROJECTS.title: NASA Explorer
PROJECTS.description: Ask questions about NASA space-biology research and get answers backed by published sources. I built the NestJS chat and RAG backend, a Python ingestion pipeline, and parts of the interactive React knowledge graph.
PROJECTS.context: Team of 6 • 1st Place — NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025
contributions: Built the backend — chat, history, users, and RAG orchestration with Vertex AI.
Developed frontend features: interactive knowledge graph, article favorites, and chat integration.

PROJECTS.title: Awita
PROJECTS.description: I built this system to help my family avoid running out of water. An Arduino checks the tank every minute, AWS handles the readings, and a React dashboard shows the level and sends alerts. It has run at home for over a year.
contributions: Designed the full system — Arduino firmware, a Go Lambda for sensor ingestion, the NestJS API, and the React dashboard.
Trained an LSTM to forecast when the tank would empty, measured it against the latency it added, and switched it off.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: Marswalk
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: Plan a spacesuit walk on real NASA terrain of Mars, then walk it in 3D before your oxygen runs out. Built by a team of 6 at NASA Space Apps 2026. I worked across the whole app, from the NASA data to multiplayer and the in-app presentation.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: CTRL Coders
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: The website of the competitive programming club I co-founded at UABC. I built it alone: video guides for the omegaUp judge, the club's latest Instagram posts synced every hour by a Cloudflare Worker, and a raffle with an admin dashboard on Supabase.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: Havi
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: At a two-day banking hackathon, I built the 8-screen mobile app for a proactive banking copilot. Its typed data layer combines pipeline alerts with account data and falls back to demo data when the backend is unavailable.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: The Autism Compass
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: The mobile app for the Tech4Good lab's autism-screening platform, which I architected and built. Caregivers run screening questionnaires such as ATEC and M-CHAT-R/F, see results by area, and link specialists to each person. It won 1st place in Engineering at ENITCI 2025.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: Espyntar
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: A C++ drawing game for up to eight players. Custom TCP messages keep the canvas, guesses and scores in sync across clients.

OTHER_PROJECTS.title: 16-BDH
OTHER_PROJECTS.description: A three-level RPG that teaches the Battle of Puebla through play. Built with a custom C and Raylib engine and released for desktop and web.

TEXT_MORE_ABOUT_1: I discovered my passion for programming at 16 through Arduino projects, which sparked my interest in software development. This early experience taught me the importance of problem-solving and creative thinking in technology.
TEXT_MORE_ABOUT_2: When I'm not coding, I enjoy gaming, spending time with friends and family, and playing guitar. I'm always eager to learn and chat about new tech.

HIGHLIGHTS.title: Co-founder
HIGHLIGHTS.description: Co-founded the university programming club, led workshops, mentored students and built its website.

HIGHLIGHTS.title: 1st Place, Engineering & Technology Division
HIGHLIGHTS.description: Presented a React Native app for the ASD community, recognized for its user-centered design process and its row-level access control over sensitive health data.

HIGHLIGHTS.title: 1st Place & Global Nominee
HIGHLIGHTS.description: Built a space biology knowledge engine with Vertex AI over a weekend with a team of six.

HIGHLIGHTS.title: 1st Place
HIGHLIGHTS.description: Teamed up with a partner and competed against 40+ students to win first place.
